exposure: Vaginal repair of uterine cesarean scar defect (niche)
Type of surgery (single-port laparoscopy-assisted vaginal repair vs. vaginal repair)
Single-port laparoscopy-assisted vaginal repair of uterine cesarean scar defect (niche)
cohort: 74 patients diagnosed with uterine cesarean niche at the Shanghai First Maternity and Infant Hospital from January 2013 to June 2015
finding: Single-port laparoscopy-assisted vaginal repair of uterine cesarean scars was associated with shorter gas passage time, shorter hospital stay, and fewer complications compared to vaginal repair alone.
